title: SEACAST_PRIGI_WPP573_Spatiotemporal_Oceanographic_Observation
description: Schema for monthly gridded oceanographic intelligence across WPPNRI 573 (2015-2025)

grid_id.description: Unique identifier of grid cell within WPPNRI 573 master grid

aoi_intersection_fraction.description: Fraction of cell intersecting official WPPNRI 573 boundary

sst.description: Sea Surface Temperature in deg C (Sensor fused MODIS/OISST)

sst_anomaly.description: SST Anomaly relative to OISST v2.1 1981-2010 climatological baseline in deg C

chlor_a.description: Chlorophyll-a surface concentration in mg/m3 (MODIS-Aqua L3SMI)

wind_u10.description: 10-meter eastward surface wind component in m/s (NOAA CFSv2 Harmonized)

wind_v10.description: 10-meter northward surface wind component in m/s (NOAA CFSv2 Harmonized)

wind_stress_tau.description: Magnitude of surface wind stress in Pa

current_u.description: Eastward ocean current velocity at 0m surface in m/s (HYCOM)

current_v.description: Northward ocean current velocity at 0m surface in m/s (HYCOM)

sla.description: Sea Level Anomaly in meters (Copernicus CMEMS L4)

thermal_front_gradient.description: SST spatial gradient magnitude in deg C/km via spherical metric Sobel

ekman_transport_u.description: Zonal Ekman transport component in m2/s

ekman_transport_v.description: Meridional Ekman transport component in m2/s (negative values denote offshore transport in S. Hemisphere)

bathymetry.description: Bedrock bathymetric depth in meters from ETOPO1/GEBCO (negative for ocean depths)

dist_to_200m_isobath_km.description: Euclidean geodesic distance to -200m continental shelf-break in km

data_coverage.description: Fraction of valid unclouded sensor pixels contributing to monthly composite
